e2e_case.name: mini_end_to_end
e2e_case.sop_yaml:
version: 1
rules:
  - id: lookup_on_billing
    kind: tool
    description: look the account up before answering a billing question
    activation:
      source: intents
      intents: [billing]
    obligation:
      tools: [tool:lookup_account]
    scope: conversation
  - id: quote_policy_number
    kind: speech
    description: quote the policy number back to the member
    activation: {source: always}
    obligation:
      act: quotes the policy number back to the member
      detectors:
        - {type: regex, patterns: ["policy (number|no)"]}
      combine: any
    owed_when:
      all:
        - {type: user_not_provided, patterns: ["policy (number|no)", "PN-\\d{4,}"]}
    scope: turn

      combine: any
    owed_when:

    kind: speech
    description: ask the member for their policy number and full name

      detectors:
        - {type: weak_tool_adjacent, tool: tool:verify_member, window: [0, 1]}

        - {type: zero_shot_nli, hypothesis: "This response asks for the policy number."}
      combine: all

    kind: tool

      tools: [tool:quote_competitor]
      forbidden: true
    scope: turn

    activation:
      source: labels

      sticky: true
    obligation:
      tools: [tool:get_exclusions]
    scope: conversation
  - id: fetch_rubric_before_scoring

    owed_when:
      any:
        - {type: tool_result_matches, tool: tool:load_session, key: mode, in: [scored, live]}
        - {type: final_turn}
